title: Lockstep IO checklist and compatibility sentinel for onboarded model releases
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Establish a repeatable "lockstep IO" checklist and implement a lightweight compatibility sentinel for newly onboarded, pinned model releases. The goal is to guarantee that prompt envelopes, public parameter names, and output shape semantics do not change in ways that break customer integrations while publishing a performance fingerprint (latency/cost) alongside the pinned model manifest.
acceptance_criteria: Create a canonical prompt envelope spec that is stored with the model manifest and validated by the onboarding pipeline
Define a parameter aliasing and deprecation table and ensure runtime maps deprecated names to canonical names without behavioral change

Produce an automated IO sentinel that runs on each candidate pinned release: schema checks, tokenization parity test, deterministic prefix-response smoke test, and KPI perf fingerprint (p50/p95 latency, cost/token)
Onboarded models must ship with a generated 'compatibility-report' artifact linked from the model catalog
Regression harness fails onboarding when semantic output shift crosses tolerance thresholds defined in the manifest
Publish documentation for developers describing breaking vs non-breaking parameter changes and migration guidance
implementation_notes: Add a new step to the onboarding CI: manifest-schema-validate -> alias-map-apply -> sentinel-run -> perf-fingerprint-collect
Implement sentinel as a lightweight container that runs a fixed set of prompts and compares normalized outputs using existing eval tooling
Use token-level hashing and span-level normalization to detect trivial whitespace/formatting changes vs semantic drift
Store perf fingerprints as a small JSON blob in the model registry and surface in Console and API metadata
Parameter alias map implemented as a versioned resource; runtime reads alias map at startup and applies a transparent mapping layer
Keep sentinel runtime under a 2 minute timeout and cost budget; failing sentinel should block canary rollouts, not immediate rollback
qa_plan: Unit tests for alias map logic with >95% branch coverage
Integration test: onboarding pipeline runs sentinel against last-known-good pinned manifest and current candidate
Create an e2e test that simulates a client relying on deprecated parameter names to ensure transparent mapping
Add golden outputs for canonical prompts and automate weekly re-run against production models to detect silent drift
Manual review checklist for PM/Docs: verify example prompts and sample responses in published docs
